messages.subject: Commercial Support
parts:
Does Microsoft / Revolutions provide commercial support for Microsoft R Open (not R Server, just base)?  

Thanks,

Jonathan

messages.author: 9ca0345d553844f2
messages.subject: Re: Commercial Support
parts:
Hello Jonathan,


There is no support program for standalone Microsoft R Open (MRO). However, support is available for MRO through Microsoft R Server (MRS). MRS depends on customized release of MRO for MRS. For this reason, your MRS license will also include support for MRO for MRS.


Cheers,

Josée
